<!-- head-1: body_md -->
For robot control, we are interested in a specific type of elastic mode, where we allow for both hard equality constraints, and elastic inequality constraints. Dynamics constraints are posed as equalities, and these are always physically consistent with each other, and meaningless if relaxed (for instance, a solution where torques and accelerations are incompatible). If equalities are possibly-inconsistent, non-dynamics terms, these can always be made elastic via opposing elastic inequalities.
<!-- end head-1 -->
